'''STAPs''' were a make of one-man [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Produced by [[Longspur and Alloi]], the vehicles were [[Color/Legends|silver]] in color, forming a T-shape with a small [[Engine/Legends|engine]] on each side as well as an extension for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to stand on. The craft did not include any built in weaponry.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
STAPs first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]]. The vehicle was given along with several other items to any players who brought the Digital edition of the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
